# Top Hat

> > Top Hat is an education technology platform providing interactive classroom engagement tools, digital textbooks, and teaching solutions for higher education institutions.

Top Hat offers comprehensive solutions for active learning, student engagement, and course content delivery, serving professors and universities across North America. The platform combines classroom response systems, interactive digital content, and teaching resources to enhance both in-person and online learning experiences.
